The '''Whiplash Council''' was the governing body of the [[Whiplash]] resistance movement after the Whiplash leader, [[Thi Xon Yimmon]] was captured. Formed by [[Tuden Sal]], the Council's members included [[Sheel Mafeen]], [[Acer Ash]], [[Fars Sil-at]], and [[Dyat Agni]]. Most of its members were killed during a [[Attack on the Emperor's Villa|failed attack]] on [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Emperor's Villa|villa]].
